cli.intro: OpenCAD — create, edit and inspect drawings on one native model.

cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.create: Create an empty drawing and save it to a project file
cmd.open: Open a drawing file and print its revision, layers and entities
cmd.undo: Restore the previous document from the file's history sidecar and save it in place
cmd.redo: Reapply the snapshot the last undo replaced and save it in place
cmd.inspect: Run the declared checks on a drawing file
cmd.export: Project a drawing file into an exchange format
cmd.import: Create a new drawing from the ASCII DXF subset (LINE, ARC, ELLIPSE, POINT, INSERT, LWPOLYLINE, POLYLINE, SPLINE, LEADER, MLEADER, HATCH); approximations and skipped entities are reported as losses
cmd.entity: Edit the entities of an existing drawing file
cmd.arc: Add a circular arc to an existing drawing file
cmd.arc-add: Add a counter-clockwise arc and save the file in place
cmd.arc-update: Update an arc's radius or sweep angles and save the file
cmd.ellipse: Add a full or partial ellipse to an existing drawing file
cmd.ellipse-add: Add an ellipse and save the file in place
cmd.polyline: Edit the vertices of a polyline in an existing drawing file
cmd.polyline-update: Replace polyline vertices or set its closed flag and save the file
cmd.polyline-insert: Insert one vertex into a polyline and save the file
cmd.polyline-remove: Remove one vertex from a polyline and save the file
cmd.polyline-move: Move one vertex of a polyline and save the file
cmd.transform: Translate, rotate, scale or mirror a selection and save the file
cmd.copy: Duplicate entities with a cumulative offset and save the file
cmd.array: Duplicate entities into a rectangular or polar array and save the file
cmd.explode: Replace one polyline with independent line entities and save the file
cmd.offset: Offset a circle, arc, polyline or line into a new entity and save the file
cmd.trim: Trim a line at a line, circle or arc cutter, keeping the longer side, and save the file
cmd.extend: Extend a line to its nearest line, circle or arc boundary and save the file
cmd.fillet: Fillet two lines with a tangent arc, trimming both, and save the file
cmd.chamfer: Chamfer two lines with a bevel, trimming both, and save the file
cmd.measure: Measure bounds, path length and enclosed area of a drawing file; pass --ids to measure single entities
cmd.measure-points: Measure the distance between two points or the angle at three points
cmd.stats: Report entity count, path length and enclosed area per layer
cmd.select: Select entities inside or crossing a rectangular window without changing the drawing
cmd.snap: Compute endpoint, midpoint, centre and line-intersection snap points without changing the drawing
cmd.ucs: Convert points and entities between world and user coordinates and save the file
cmd.add-line: Add a line and save the file in place
cmd.add-point: Add a point entity and save the file in place
cmd.add-circle: Add a circle and save the file in place
cmd.add-polyline: Add a polyline and save the file in place
cmd.add-spline: Add a cubic spline through its fit points and save the file in place
cmd.add-rectangle: Add an axis-aligned rectangle as a closed polyline and save the file in place
cmd.add-polygon: Add a regular polygon as a closed polyline and save the file in place
cmd.add-hatch: Add a hatch bounded by a closed polygon and save the file in place
cmd.add-text: Add single-line text and save the file in place
cmd.add-dimension: Add a linear dimension and save the file in place
cmd.add-radial-dimension: Add a radial or diameter dimension and save the file in place
cmd.add-ordinate-dimension: Add an ordinate dimension and save the file in place
cmd.add-angular-dimension: Add an angular dimension swept counter-clockwise from the first ray to the second and save the file in place
cmd.delete: Delete one entity by id and save the file in place
cmd.list: List the entities of a drawing file
cmd.move: Move one entity by an offset or to an absolute point and save the file
cmd.update: Update text content/height or a circle radius and save the file
cmd.set-layer: Move one entity onto another layer and save the file
cmd.layer: Add and edit the layers of an existing drawing file
cmd.layer-add: Add a layer and save the file in place
cmd.layer-rename: Rename a layer, rewriting entity references, and save the file
cmd.layer-visible: Set a layer's visibility and save the file in place
cmd.layer-lock: Set a layer's lock state and save the file in place
cmd.layer-freeze: Set a layer's freeze state and save the file in place
cmd.layer-plot: Set whether a layer is included in plots and save the file in place
cmd.layer-merge: Move every entity of one layer onto another and remove the empty source layer
cmd.layer-delete: Delete an empty layer and save the file in place
cmd.layer-set: Assign a line type or lineweight to a layer and save the file in place
cmd.linetype: Read and edit the line types of an existing drawing file
cmd.linetype-list: List the line types of a drawing file
cmd.linetype-add: Add a line type with an optional dash pattern and save the file in place
cmd.linetype-update: Update a line type, optionally renaming it, and save the file
cmd.linetype-delete: Delete a line type and save the file in place
cmd.dimstyle: Read and edit the dimension styles of an existing drawing file
cmd.dimstyle-list: List the dimension styles of a drawing file
cmd.dimstyle-add: Add a dimension style and save the file in place
cmd.dimstyle-update: Update a dimension style, optionally renaming it, and save the file
cmd.dimstyle-delete: Delete a dimension style and save the file in place
cmd.textstyle: Read and edit the text styles of an existing drawing file
cmd.textstyle-list: List the text styles of a drawing file
cmd.textstyle-add: Add a text style and save the file in place
cmd.textstyle-update: Update a text style, optionally renaming it, and save the file
cmd.textstyle-delete: Delete a text style and save the file in place
cmd.text: Find and replace the content of text entities in an existing drawing file
cmd.text-find: List the text entities whose content contains a pattern
cmd.text-replace: Replace a pattern in every matching text entity and save the file
cmd.group: Read and edit the entity groups of an existing drawing file
cmd.group-list: List the entity groups of a drawing file
cmd.group-create: Create a named entity group and save the file in place
cmd.group-delete: Delete an entity group and save the file in place
cmd.group-add: Add entities to a group and save the file in place
cmd.group-remove: Remove entities from a group and save the file in place
cmd.units: Convert the lengths of an existing drawing file between millimetres and inches
cmd.units-convert: Scale every length and change the declared unit, then save the file in place
cmd.properties: Read and edit the title and descriptive properties of an existing drawing file
cmd.properties-show: Print the title, author, company, project, description and keywords
cmd.properties-set: Update one or more drawing properties and save the file in place

opt.title: Drawing title
opt.template: Accepted for compatibility; no template is loaded yet
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.checks: Comma-separated checks: units, layers, geometry, polylines, dimensions, duplicate-entity, zero-length, open-contour (constraints and references are not implemented)
opt.format: Exchange format to write: dxf, obj, step, stl, svg or pdf (obj, step and stl extrude closed profiles)
opt.layer: Target layer id (defaults to 0; dimensions default to dimensions)
opt.center: Circle, arc or ellipse centre as x,y
opt.radius: Circle or arc radius in drawing units
opt.start-angle: Start angle in degrees (arcs are counter-clockwise)
opt.end-angle: End angle in degrees; defaults to a full turn
opt.rx: Ellipse radius along the major axis
opt.ry: Ellipse radius along the minor axis
opt.all: Select every entity in the drawing
opt.mirror: Mirror axis: x reflects across y=at, y reflects across x=at
opt.pivot: Rotation or scale pivot as x,y
opt.mirror-at: Coordinate of the mirror line on the mirrored axis; defaults to 0
opt.count: Number of copies or polar array items, 1-10000
opt.rows: Rectangular array rows including the source, 1-10000
opt.columns: Rectangular array columns including the source, 1-10000
opt.row-spacing: Vertical distance between adjacent array rows
opt.column-spacing: Horizontal distance between adjacent array columns
opt.total-angle: Polar array total angle in degrees; copies are placed counter-clockwise
opt.sheet: Sheets are not modelled; a non-empty value is rejected
opt.crossing: Select entities that cross or touch the box instead of only fully contained ones
opt.select-layer: Restrict the selection to one layer id
opt.snap-modes: Comma-separated snap modes: endpoint, midpoint, center, quadrant, nearest, intersection, perpendicular, tangent (defaults to endpoint, midpoint, center, intersection)
opt.ucs-origin: UCS origin in world coordinates as x,y; defaults to 0,0
opt.ucs-rotation: Angle of the UCS X axis from the world X axis in degrees; defaults to 0
opt.ucs-direction: Conversion direction: to-world converts UCS values into world coordinates, to-ucs converts world coordinates into the UCS
opt.near: Probe point as x,y; candidates are sorted by distance to it
opt.tolerance: Keep only snap candidates within this distance of --near
opt.spline-points: Spline fit points as "x,y x,y ..."; at least two are required
opt.rectangle-from: First rectangle corner as x,y; the opposite corner must lie right of and above it
opt.polygon-radius: Regular polygon circumradius in drawing units
opt.polygon-rotation: Angle of the first polygon vertex in degrees, counter-clockwise; defaults to 0
opt.points-list: Two or three points as "x,y x,y ..."; the second of three is the angle vertex
opt.pattern: Hatch pattern name; defaults to SOLID
opt.closed: Close the polyline back to its first vertex
opt.closed-state: Polyline closed flag: on or off
opt.vertex-index: Zero-based vertex index; insertion accepts the current vertex count to append
opt.vertex-move-at: New position of the moved vertex as x,y
opt.target-layer: Target layer id that receives the entity
opt.height: Text cap height in drawing units
opt.pattern: Non-empty text pattern to find or replace
opt.replacement: Replacement text; an empty value deletes the matched substrings
opt.match-case: Match case exactly instead of the default ASCII case-insensitive search
opt.group-name: Entity group name, which also acts as the group id
opt.offset: Signed distance of the dimension line from the measured segment
opt.distance: Offset distance; positive grows radii and offsets left, negative shrinks or offsets right, and --side requires a positive value
opt.offset-side: Offset direction: left or right for lines and polylines, outside or inside for circles and arcs
opt.first: First line entity id for fillet or chamfer
opt.second: Second line entity id for fillet or chamfer
opt.cutter: Cutter entity id for trim: a line, circle or arc
opt.extend-to: Boundary entity id for extend: a line, circle or arc
opt.extend-side: Which endpoint to extend: end (default) or start
opt.distance-a: Trim distance along the first line for a chamfer
opt.distance-b: Trim distance along the second line for a chamfer; defaults to the first distance
opt.angle: Angle of the measured circle point in degrees, counter-clockwise
opt.diameter: Measure the diameter instead of the radius
opt.first: A point on the first measured ray as x,y
opt.second: A point on the second measured ray as x,y
opt.feature: Ordinate measured feature point as x,y
opt.axis: Axis the ordinate dimension measures: x or y
opt.to-point: Absolute target point for the entity anchor as x,y
opt.name: Layer name, which also acts as the layer id
opt.locked: Layer lock state: on or off
opt.frozen: Layer freeze state: on or off (frozen layers are hidden from exports and read-only)
opt.plottable: Whether plots and print exports include the layer: on or off
opt.layer-from: Source layer whose entities move; the layer is removed after the merge
opt.layer-to: Target layer that receives the entities
opt.linetype: Line type id assigned to the layer
opt.lineweight: Lineweight in millimetres, 0-10; 0 uses the exporter default
opt.linetype-name: Line type name, which also acts as the id
opt.linetype-pattern: Comma-separated dash lengths in drawing units; omit for a solid line
opt.style-name: Dimension style name, which also acts as the style id
opt.scale: Overall scale applied to the dimension style's lengths
opt.text-height: Dimension text height in drawing units
opt.extension: Extension line length beyond the dimension line
opt.origin-offset: Gap between a measured point and its extension line
opt.precision: Decimal places in a measured label, 0-8
opt.text-style-name: Text style name, which also acts as the style id
opt.font: Primary font file or family name
opt.fixed-height: Fixed text cap height; 0 leaves the height to each text entity
opt.width-factor: Horizontal text width factor; 1 is normal
opt.oblique: Text oblique angle in degrees, -85 to 85
opt.to-unit: Unit to convert to: mm or inch
opt.author: Drawing author
